name: Shell Bell
description: A hold item that restores HP upon striking the foe.

gifts.mapName: Shoal Cave Low Tide Entrance Room
gifts.note: Bring 4 Shoal Salt and 4 Shoal Shells. The old man at the entrance of Shoal Cave (surf from Route 125) makes a Shell Bell each time you bring him 4 Shoal Salt and 4 Shoal Shells. Collect them inside the cave; some are only reachable at low tide, and they refill each day.
